directions.text: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
And he saith unto them, Oye of little faith, Why are ye fearful?
and rebuked the winds and the sea;
and there was a great calm.
saying: What manner of man is this,
that even the winds and the sea obey him!
